summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of feed rate fix implementation. All 5 operations (Freze, Matkap, Torna, Kılavuz/Diş, Chatter-free) now have independent per-operation feed modes with correct defaults. Settings page shows 5 separate toggles. Feed values display correctly with no thousand separators and decimal points in G-code. Critical warnings, G-code copy, and all regression items verified.
passed_tests: Default modes: Freze=G94 (mm/dk), Matkap=G94 (mm/dk), Torna=G95 (mm/dev), Kılavuz/Diş=G95 (mm/dev), Chatter-free=G94 (mm/dk)
Feed values: Freze shows 1188 (no thousand separator), Matkap shows 407, Torna shows 0,220, Diş shows 1,000
G-code format: Freze 'G94 S3714 F1188', Matkap 'G94 S2546 F407', Torna 'G95 S1146 F0.220', Diş 'G95 S424 F1.000'
Settings page: 5 feed mode rows with correct testIds (settings-feed-mode-freze/matkap/torna/dis/chatter)
Settings chips: Correct default badges showing 'mm/dk · G94' for freze/matkap/chatter and 'mm/dev · G95' for torna/dis
Independence: Changing Freze to G95 in Settings doesn't affect Matkap (stays G94)
Independence: Changing Torna to G94 via FeedCard toggle doesn't affect Freze
localStorage persistence: Feed mode selections persist after page reload (verified in localStorage: feedModeByOp object present)
Critical warning: Entering 1,3 in Matkap input-f triggers red banner and 'KONTROL ET!' chip
Critical warning clear: Changing back to 0,16 removes warning and shows 'Güvenli aralık'
G-code copy: Button works without console errors (shows toast)
Regression: RPM values unchanged (Freze=3714, Matkap=2546, Torna=1146)
Regression: All calculated values (Q, power, torque, hm, Ra) display correctly
Regression: Material selector, hardness card, recommendation panel 'Tümünü uygula' work
Regression: Save and Share buttons present and functional
Regression: Settings unit system toggle (Metric/Inch) works
Regression: Export/Import data buttons present
Inch mode: Switching to Inch shows IPM units, G-code uses decimal point (F46.79), app doesn't crash
Feed value format: G94 values show as integers (1188, 407), G95 values show 3 decimals (0.320, 0.220, 1.000)
Active cell highlighting: Correct mode cell highlighted in FeedCard (G94 or G95 based on operation)
